name: Scissor Gavialwatch
original_name: シザー・ガビアルウォッチ
source:
The Commander of the Navy in Neverland.

Even though he’s has long hair and appears well-organized, he’s quite messy and has a mad personality.

He likes the word, “destruction”, and take every opportunity to destroy things. He adores his pet Watch Crocodile who pulverizes every toy it’s given.

He likes sweets that he can crumble. His favourite is biscuits that go well with tea. He destroys the things he likes.

[From [url=http://appleforest.livejournal.com/4145.html]Appleforest at Livejournal[/url]]
